parts.text: $CROX Q3 2026: revenue $1.0B, +5% Y/Y, driven by higher unit sales volume and tariff refunds. Operating margin 28.0% as gross margins expanded. #earnings #materials

$ATR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.0B, +6% Y/Y, driven by broad sales gains across pharma, beauty, and closures segments. Operating margin 13.2%, with net earnings impacted by the Russian subsidiary deconsolidation. #earnings #materials

$FCN Q3 2026: Revenue was $1.0B, up 6% Y/Y, with an operating margin of 8.9%. Costs grew faster than sales, and the company recorded special charges for headcount reductions to align staffing with demand. #earnings #industrials

$ENTG Q3 2026: revenue rose as higher demand across both segments supported advanced logic and memory production. Revenue reached $1.0B, up 25% Y/Y, with an operating margin of 22.9%. #earnings #materials

$LYB Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $8.5B, +10% Y/Y, supported by higher oxyfuels profitability and strong Intermediates & Derivatives margins. Operating margin 8.9%; net earnings $758M. #earnings #materials
$RSG Q3 2026: revenue $5.2B, +8% Y/Y, driven by positive average yield across all lines of business despite a decline in residential collection volume. Operating margin 17.7%. #earnings #utilities
$BTSG Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $4.2B, +26% Y/Y, driven by pharmacy and provider services. Operating margin 3.8% as the company increased full-year guidance. #earnings #healthcare

$LNT Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.3B, +6% Y/Y, driven by electric utility growth. Operating margin 30.3%; net earnings $398M. Guides 2027 EPS to $3.63–$3.73 and increases 4-year capex forecast to $15.9B. #earnings #utilities
$AN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $7.0B, flat Y/Y, driven by record after-sales gross profit and AutoNation Finance growth. Operating margin 4.5%; operating cash flow $209M. #earnings #retail

$LEA Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $5.8B, +2% Y/Y, driven by new business and commercial recoveries despite lower industry production. Operating margin 3.3%; operating cash flow $329M. #earnings #autos
$BNY $BK Q3 2026: revenue $5.7B, +12% Y/Y, driven by higher fee revenue and net interest income from net new business and client activity. Operating margin 38.5%. #earnings #banks

$REGN Q3 2026: revenue $5.1B, +36% Y/Y, driven by collaboration revenue which rose 52% and accounted for 59% of total sales. Operating margin reached 40.0%, with net earnings of $1.9B. #earnings #pharma
